name: workflow
description: Skills, an acceptance-check agent and hooks for the development flow from request to merge (including how PR reviews are routed and awaited), issue operations, session handoffs and runbook recording, plus a mod that writes usage limits to a file

review_heavy.title: Review tools for heavy PRs
review_heavy.description: Review tools for heavy PRs when the repo's CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md has no review-heavy: line (comma-separated, e.g. coderabbit,codex; none means no tool). Available ids: codex, coderabbit, copilot, gemini, cursor-bugbot. If empty, pr-review-triage asks the user

review_light.title: Review for light PRs
review_light.description: What reviews light PRs when the repo's CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md has no review-light: line. claude means Claude reviews. Tool ids (e.g. coderabbit,codex) treat light PRs like heavy ones (no review:light label). A list such as claude,codex means Claude reviews and the listed tools' results are awaited too

review_auto.title: Automatic tool reviews (on / off)
review_auto.description: Value used when the repo's CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md has no review-auto: line. on keeps the tools' automatic reviews on and creates only light PRs with the review:light label to exclude them. off assumes automatic reviews are turned off and requests a review per PR

rereview_threshold.title: Serious findings that trigger a re-review
rereview_threshold.description: Ask the tools used in that round for a re-review only when at least this many serious findings (CodeRabbit Critical / Codex P1 / Critical or High for others) were fixed

freshness_targets.title: Directories the knowledge-freshness hook checks
freshness_targets.description: Comma-separated <dir>:<glob> pairs; ~ in a dir is expanded; ** in a glob is recursive; a dir cannot contain a comma. The hook warns at session start about files there whose review_after has passed or that have no last_reviewed. Empty means the default (~/.claude/rules:*.md,~/.claude/reference:*.md,~/.claude/skills:*/SKILL.md)

commit_gate.title: Commit gate mode (off / observe / enforce)
commit_gate.description: off does nothing. observe never blocks and says what it would have done at git commit. enforce blocks a commit when no review or verification ran on the tree being committed, or the message's Verification: trailer does not match. A repo's .claude/verification.json on the default branch overrides this

commit_gate_verifiers.title: Skills that count as verification (regex)
commit_gate_verifiers.description: Regex of skill names whose run counts as review or verification for the commit gate. Empty means ^(code-review|(.+:)?verify-.+|coderabbit:code-review)$. A repo's .claude/verification.json "verifiers" overrides this

timezone.title: Time zone for the now-context line
timezone.description: IANA time zone name (e.g. Asia/Tokyo, UTC, America/New_York) used by the now-context hook, which adds the current date and time to every prompt. Empty means the system time zone; a name that does not resolve also falls back to it

decision_capture.title: Decision capture mode (off / observe / enforce)
decision_capture.description: off does nothing. observe never blocks and records in the hook's state when a reply would have been blocked. enforce blocks Stop once when the last reply asks for a decision in prose and the turn neither used AskUserQuestion nor ran the registration command

decision_register_command.title: Command that records a decision
decision_register_command.description: Optional template of a command that records a decision somewhere you track them, with {key} and {decision} placeholders (for example mytool decisions add --key {key} --decision {decision}). A Bash command that starts with the part before the first { counts as recording. Empty means the block only suggests AskUserQuestion

decision_stop_limit.title: Dismissals in a row before decision capture goes quiet
decision_stop_limit.description: After this many dismissals in a row in one session, decision capture stops blocking in that session for 12 hours. Using AskUserQuestion or the registration command resets the count

decision_judge.title: Judge for decision capture (regex / openai / typesafe / google)
decision_judge.description: regex uses local patterns and sends nothing out. openai (OpenAI Decisions API), typesafe (TypeSafe Jev) and google (Gemini Decisions API) send the last 1500 characters of a reply that passes a loose pre-filter to that vendor, with the key below; without a key or on any error they fall back to regex

decision_judge_threshold.title: Judge threshold override
decision_judge_threshold.description: A number between 0 and 1. A reply counts as asking for a decision when the vendor's score is at least this. Empty means the vendor's default (openai 0.9, typesafe 0.97, google 0.8)

decision_openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key for the decision judge
decision_openai_api_key.description: Used only when decision_judge is openai

decision_typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key for the decision judge
decision_typesafe_api_key.description: Used only when decision_judge is typesafe

decision_google_api_key.title: Gemini API key for the decision judge
decision_google_api_key.description: Used only when decision_judge is google

pr_checks_gate.title: Local checks before a PR (off / observe / enforce)
pr_checks_gate.description: off does nothing. observe never blocks and logs, at PR creation, whether the repo's check command (prChecks in .claude/verification.json on the default branch) passed locally on the tree being proposed. enforce blocks a PR creation with no recorded pass. A repo's .claude/verification.json prChecksGate on the default branch overrides this
